zh: 能说清楚的道理，往往不是那个最根本的道理。
en: The Way that can be told is not the constant Way.

zh: 有和无、难和易，都是互相衬出来的。
en: Being and non-being, hard and easy, give rise to each other.

zh: 不硬来、顺着规律做，事情反而顺。
en: Act without forcing; then nothing is left unmanaged.

zh: 不张扬，也不刻意清高，和周围人处在一起。
en: Soften your light and blend with the dust.

zh: 说多了容易失手，不如守住中道。
en: Words run out; better to hold to the centre.

zh: 天地不急着为自己争，反而长久。
en: Heaven and earth endure because they do not strive for themselves.

quote: 上善若水，水善利万物而不争
zh: 最好的品性像水：滋养万物，却不争抢。
en: The highest good is like water: it benefits all things without contending.

zh: 端得太满容易洒，不如适时停下。
en: A cup filled to the brim is better left alone.

quote: 有之以为利，无之以为用
zh: 有东西带来便利，留出空处才真正好用。
en: What exists gives advantage; what is empty makes it useful.

zh: 花样太多，反而看不清重点。
en: Too many colours blind the eye.

zh: 太在意夸赞和难堪，心就总被牵着走。
en: Favour and disgrace both disturb the heart.

zh: 把心放空一点，安静下来，才看得清。
en: Empty yourself; keep still, and you begin to see clearly.

zh: 最好的带领，是大家只知道有这么个人在。
en: The best leader is one the people barely notice.

zh: 简单一点、少一点私心，日子更踏实。
en: Keep to plainness and simplicity; lessen private wants.

zh: 能弯一点，反而更容易保全、走直。
en: Yield and you stay whole; bend and you straighten.

zh: 踮脚站不久，跨大步走不远。
en: He who stands on tiptoe does not stand firm.

quote: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然
zh: 人学大地，大地学天，天学道，道就是顺其自然。
en: Humans follow earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows the Way, the Way follows nature.

zh: 稳重是轻浮的根，安静能管住急躁。
en: The heavy is the root of the light; stillness masters haste.

zh: 真正会做的人，做事不留痕迹。
en: Good action leaves no tracks.

zh: 知道强势，却愿意守住柔和。
en: Know the masculine, keep to the feminine.

zh: 看懂别人是聪明，看懂自己才算明白。
en: Knowing others is wisdom; knowing yourself is clarity.

zh: 想收拢，先让它自然舒展；做事别硬拧。
en: To gather, first let it spread.

zh: 顺着规律不硬做，却没有什么做不成。
en: The Way does nothing, yet nothing is left undone.

zh: 真有德的人不把「德」挂嘴边。
en: Highest virtue does not claim to be virtue.

quote: 贵以贱为本，高以下为基
zh: 高的要从低的托着，别忘根本。
en: The noble takes the humble as its root.

zh: 往回走、往低处走，也是道在动。
en: Return is the movement of the Way.

zh: 大器晚成，最大的声音反而听不见。
en: Great vessels are finished late; the greatest sound is barely heard.

quote: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物
zh: 万物从简单的一路生发出来。
en: The Way gives rise to one, one to two, two to three, three to all things.

zh: 懂得满足和停下，就不容易受挫。
en: Know contentment and you avoid disgrace; know when to stop and you avoid danger.

zh: 麻烦常从「永远不够」开始。
en: No disaster is greater than not knowing when enough is enough.

zh: 空着的山谷能生养万物，空不是没有用。
en: The valley spirit never dies; emptiness is generative.

zh: 身心能不能不散着，专心守在一个地方。
en: Can you hold body and spirit together without drifting apart?

zh: 懂得从前的道理，才好应对眼前的事。
en: Hold to the Way of old to steer what is here now.

zh: 谨慎得像冬天过河，慢一点反而稳。
en: Cautious as one crossing a river in winter.

zh: 自然的路走丢了，才需要格外讲规矩。
en: When the great Way is lost, talk of kindness appears.

zh: 别人都显得很明白，我宁愿糊涂一点。
en: Others are bright; I seem dim.

zh: 真正的德，是跟着规律走出来的。
en: Great virtue follows the Way alone.

quote: 飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日
zh: 狂风暴雨都长不了，急事也会过去。
en: A squall does not last the morning; hard times pass.

quote: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已
zh: 硬要掌控一切，往往做不成。
en: To force the world into shape rarely works.

quote: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下
zh: 真正会帮人的，不靠强硬压人。
en: Help others by the Way, not by force.

zh: 动武是最后的手段，不该当好事炫耀。
en: Weapons are tools of ill omen, not to be celebrated.

quote: 道常无名，朴虽小，天下莫能臣
zh: 朴素看着不起眼，却最难被摆布。
en: The uncarved block seems small, yet nothing can master it.

zh: 大道就在身边，往左往右都能看见。
en: The great Way flows everywhere, left and right.

zh: 抓住根本，人和事自然靠过来。
en: Hold the great image, and the world comes to you.

quote: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚
zh: 最软的东西，能穿过最硬的东西。
en: The softest thing outruns the hardest.

zh: 真正完整的东西，看着好像还缺一点。
en: Great completion seems incomplete, yet never wears out.

zh: 不出门也能懂天下，关键在会看会想。
en: Without leaving the door, one may know the world.

zh: 学知识是加法，修心是减法。
en: Learning adds; the Way subtracts.

quote: 圣人无常心，以百姓心为心
zh: 会带人的人，先听大家怎么想。
en: The wise hold no fixed mind; they take the people's mind as theirs.

zh: 生和死是一体两面，认真活好当下。
en: From birth we move toward death; live this day well.

zh: 万物由道而生，由德而养。
en: The Way gives life; virtue nourishes it.
